data.privacy: Public-sky tools and Sun-sign horoscopes need no birth details. The compatibility, occasion, chart-twin, birthday and milestone tools, and a personal weekly forecast in get_horoscope, take the dates you give for that answer only and save none of them. Zodiacs never stores or logs birth details. Links never carry a birth year, a birth time, a birthplace or the names you give; a birthday link carries only the month and day. Ask before using someone else's birth details. The assistant provider can receive tool arguments and results. Hosted calculations run on Zodiacs infrastructure. Chart Studio calculates in the browser; only explicitly reviewed selections are sent to the assistant. Hosting-layer request metadata has a separate retention policy, set out in the privacy policy: https://zodiacs.org/privacy/. Links to zodiacs.org end in ?ref=chatgpt or ?ref=assistant so the site can count those visits; the page removes it as it opens. The occasion, compatibility, chart-twin and birthday tools take dates, and birth dates with an optional time, time zone, place and first names, for one or two people; they calculate from them for that call and save none of it. The result goes to the assistant. Share links and card links leave out names and raw birth details, and coordinates in a link are rounded to two decimals. A birthday gets no card link and no share link, because that date can be a birth date. The famous-chart and sky-calendar tools need no personal details. Zodiacs is not directed at children under 13: its tools make no card, chart or reading from a birth date less than 13 years ago, or a birthday card for a day in those years. The natal chart, personal transit and Chinese zodiac tools take a birth date, with an optional time, time zone and coordinates for the first two, for that call only and save none of it; the period horoscope and explainer tools take no personal details.
limitations: Tropical geocentric positions; supported reference span is stated in each receipt.
Event completeness is tested, not proven. Budget exhaustion refuses the whole search.

Eclipses are listed by get_sky_calendar, get_horoscope_period and get_personal_transits (year-ahead). Exact aspects to a birth chart are listed by get_personal_transits. get_upcoming_events lists ingresses, stations and lunations. No birth-time rectification, reminders or account access.

Horoscopes are dated Sun-sign readings for the day before, the day of and the day after the current edition; with a birth date, get_horoscope also gives a personal forecast for the week from the person’s own chart.
Current means the server instant; daily sky files are separate noon-UTC snapshots.

The occasion tools give the sky on a date, rate it from 0 to 100 by astrology's traditional reading, can rate every day in a window of up to 92 days and name the three best, and give the dates of astrology's life milestones; they do not guarantee how a day will go.

Compatibility scores two charts by astrology's reading of their contacts; it does not guarantee how a relationship will go. Compatibility readings are for two adults: when either birth date is under 18 it gives no reading, and from 13 to 17 it points to a friendship reading of the two Sun signs instead. Famous charts, alone or compared with someone's own, cover only the people Zodiacs publishes, cast for local noon because their birth times are not on record.

Version 0.6.0 adds tools listed in tools/list: get_natal_chart (a birth chart readout), get_horoscope_period (monthly, yearly and weekly horoscopes from the published readings), get_chinese_zodiac (the Chinese zodiac), get_personal_transits (dated personal transits for up to 366 days or the year ahead), explain_astrology (explainers of astrology basics) and find_birthplace (a town or city name, with coordinates and a time zone for the chart tools). They give astrology's reading plainly, with a reading-confidence label on each forecast (how specific the details were, not the odds that an event happens), never a guarantee, and no health, financial or medical advice. With them Zodiacs offers 19 tools: the 13 in the tools field and these 6.
